in_telugu.name: యుధిష్ఠిర

in_marathi.name: Yudhishth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who is steadfast in war
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yudhishth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yudhishth is a popular Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit words 'yudh' (war) and 'sth' (steadfast). It signifies one who is firm and resolute in warfare.
